# Lu Cheng Agent Semantic Atlas (LCASA)

> Agent-facing external semantic coordinate and bounded structural-transfer layer.

Canonical identity:
- name: Lu Cheng Agent Semantic Atlas
- short name: LCASA
- version: 0.2.0
- origin: Lu Cheng (Jack Lu)
- origin date: 2026-09-11
- website: https://agentarchitect.me/

Primary machine entrypoints:
- agent/manifest.json
- registry/concepts.jsonl
- registry/bridges.jsonl
- registry/failures.jsonl
- bench/benchmark_results.json

Core operation:
observe -> compress -> locate -> bridge -> expand -> boundary-check -> test -> write-back

Core distinction:
MCP gives agents tools/context access. A2A gives independent agents communication/task interoperability. Memory stores history. RAG retrieves similar stored material. LCASA attempts to expose reusable invariant structures and bounded cross-domain transfers.

Mandatory caution:
Every transfer is provisional. Preserve conserved_features, inspect broken_features, and validate with target-domain evidence. Do not use LCASA to evade safeguards or authorization boundaries.
